description: Losing the native-helper connection during recording must fail closed, invalidate in-flight capture authority, and prevent later visible content from being recorded until explicit recovery.

steps.notes: Disconnect while the top content is the last authorized visible unit.
Restart must recover the unfinished stored session as INTERRUPTED, not RECORDING.

must_not_observe.notes: This becomes visible only after helper authority is lost.

hard_gates: helper disconnect removes local capture authority immediately
no content visible only after disconnect reaches durable outputs
process restart does not silently restore RECORDING
